title: Off-road desert driving in Abu Dhabi — Liwa Crossing and preparation guide
publisher: Experience Abu Dhabi / Department of Culture and Tourism — Abu Dhabi
coverage: Official desert-driving guide with six routes, including Liwa Crossing, preparation, vehicle suitability and route difficulty. Broader Abu Dhabi coverage, with a specific Liwa section; not a dedicated Liwa natural-history book or a live route-access notice.

title: محافظة الداخلية — عراقة الماضي ورونق الحاضر
publisher: Oman Ministry of Heritage and Tourism / Experience Oman
coverage: A 76-page regional visitor brochure about Al Dakhiliyah, including the Al Hamra/Jebel Shams mountain setting alongside towns, heritage and other attractions. It is not a dedicated summit route guide.

title: Welcome to the Black Forest National Park
publisher: Black Forest National Park / Nationalpark Schwarzwald
coverage: Official illustrated visitor brochure about the national park, its recovering forest, wildlife, conservation, visitor rules and access. Covers the national park within the northern Black Forest, not the entire Black Forest region. The publisher warns that some maps predate the park-boundary change of January 2026; use current trail notices separately.

title: Egypt Tourism Guide — Hurghada and the Red Sea
coverage: National tourism guide containing Hurghada and Red Sea destination material. Useful regional background, not a dedicated marine-safety manual. Edition date was not established; practical logistics should be checked against current official information.

title: Jordan Visitor's Guide — Wadi Rum chapter
coverage: A 28-page national visitor guide with a Wadi Rum section on printed pages 18–19, covering desert scenery, visitor-centre arrangements, guided 4x4/camel experiences and camps. It is a 2022 national guide, not a current stand-alone wilderness route manual.

title: Welcome to AlUla — visitor brochure
publisher: Experience AlUla / Royal Commission for AlUla
coverage: A 19-page destination brochure covering the sandstone landscape, oasis, heritage sites, nature experiences and visitor planning. Tourism and cultural background; events, openings and bookable activities may change.

title: Ras Al Khaimah Destination Map 2026 — Jebel Jais
publisher: Ras Al Khaimah Tourism Development Authority / Visit Ras Al Khaimah
coverage: A two-page foldout regional visitor map with Jebel Jais mountain attractions, routes and practical destination information. Accurately present it as a map/brochure, not a full book or a detailed navigational trail map.

title: Wadi Shab — official visitor information
publisher: Oman Ministry of Heritage and Tourism / Experience Oman
coverage: A regional illustrated visitor brochure containing Wadi Al Shab, including an explicit reference on printed page 31, alongside coastal settlements and other South Al Sharqiyah attractions. Not a dedicated swimming or canyon-navigation guide.

title: Jubail Mangrove Park — nature and visitor guide
publisher: Experience Abu Dhabi / Department of Culture and Tourism — Abu Dhabi
coverage: A concise official guide to mangrove ecology, boardwalks, kayaking, location and visitor questions. No suitable dedicated downloadable book was confirmed; do not advertise this as a PDF or a comprehensive book.

title: Plitvice Lakes National Park — visitor brochure
coverage: The park's official illustrated bilingual visitor brochure. Direct park-specific further reading; consult current park conditions separately for route and service changes.

title: Everglades Wilderness Trip Planner
publisher: U.S. National Park Service — Everglades National Park
coverage: A substantial practical guide to coastal wilderness paddling and camping: trip planning, seasons, permits, navigation, campsite types, supplies, wildlife, tides, weather and emergency preparation. Its focus is the park's coastal wilderness, not every Everglades visitor activity.

title: Yellowstone Resources and Issues Handbook 2026 — Geology
publisher: U.S. National Park Service — Yellowstone National Park
coverage: A 24-page geology chapter from the park's substantial annual reference handbook, suited to deeper terrain, volcanic and geothermal understanding. This link is one chapter; the handbook landing page provides the other chapters on ecosystems, vegetation, wildlife, history and related subjects.

title: Skaftafell — official area and hiking guide
coverage: Detailed park-area guide covering the glacier landscape, visitor services, camping and hiking routes with distances, durations and difficulty. No suitable current direct PDF was confirmed; trail alerts remain authoritative over general route descriptions.

title: Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park — official destination guide
publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Republic of Indonesia / Wonderful Indonesia
coverage: National tourism guide to the park's volcanic scenery, viewpoints, culture and general access. It is broader than Mount Bromo and is not a current volcanic-hazard or trail-opening notice. Descriptions of climbs must not be interpreted as current permission to approach a crater or summit.
